title: Fla. Stat. § 672.725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
Fla. Stat. § 672.725

672.725 Statute of limitations in contracts for sale.—(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within 4 years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than 1 year but may not extend it.

(2) A cause of action accrues when the breach occurs, regardless of the aggrieved party's lack of knowledge of the breach.

title: Fla. Stat. § 448.110 — Minimum wage enforcement
content:
Fla. Stat. § 448.110

448.110 Minimum wage enforcement.—Each employer shall pay to each employee wages at a rate of not less than the minimum wage rate set forth in s. 448.109.

title: Publix Super Markets, Inc. v. Williams, 882 So. 2d 801 (Fla. 2004)
content:
Publix Super Markets, Inc. v. Williams, 882 So. 2d 801 (Fla. 2004).

The Supreme Court of Florida addressed whether a workers' compensation immunity bar applies to an employer sued by an injured employee. The court analyzed the exclusivity provisions of the workers' compensation law and the circumstances under which an employer remains immune from tort liability.
